Master's Scholarships - Munich Data Science Institute Linde/MDSI Master's Scholarship Linde and the MDSI sponsor particularly committed and talented students of TUM's master's programs Data Engineering and Analytics as well as Mathematics in Data Science . The scholarship amounts to 1000 Euro per month for a maximum period of 12 months. Typically, each semester a new call for applications opens. For details on application requirements and the next call for applications please see here .
